verdict.rationale: Mercado Pago's subscriptions docs explicitly list 'Automatic retries if a payment is rejected,' which covers the core retry part of the story. The pack has no evidence of configurable or smart dunning schedules or customer recovery emails, and the retry claim is a single line with no detail or independent corroboration. Missing for 10: smart or configurable dunning logic (retry timing and attempt limits), automated recovery/failed-payment emails to subscribers, in-depth retry documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
